correctness.rationale: For d>=5, every error of dimensional weight at most 4 is supported on the two qubits. Products of any two such errors remain on those qubits and therefore have dimensional weight at most 4<5, so the distance-5 Knill-Laflamme condition corrects the whole two-qubit operator algebra. The full two-qubit error basis has 4^2=16 elements; non-degeneracy therefore gives 16K<=4d and K<=floor(d/4). The proof is analytic for all d>=5.
